sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check current state and untried actions
seg = current_frame.segmentation
positions = []
black_info = None
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'S':
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        positions.append((min(rows), min(cols)))
    if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] > 100:
        black_info = {'hash': n['hash'], 'children': n['children'], 'pixels': n['pixels']}
positions.sort()
print(f"Current: {positions}")
print(f"Black: pixels={black_info['pixels']}, children={black_info['children']}")
print(f"Untried: {last_action_result.get('untried_here')}")

# Try all untried arrow key actions from this state to see what happens
# First, let's try UP
result = action(['UP'], intent='explore')
print(f"\nAfter UP:")
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
positions2 = []
black_info2 = None
for n in seg2['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'S':
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        positions2.append((min(rows), min(cols)))
    if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] > 100:
        black_info2 = {'hash': n['hash'], 'children': n['children'], 'pixels': n['pixels']}
positions2.sort()
print(f"Positions: {positions2}")
print(f"Black: pixels={black_info2['pixels'] if black_info2 else 'N/A'}")
print(f"Done: {last_action_result.get('done')}")
print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
